title: Accelerando (2005)
summary: Accelerando is a science fiction novel by Charles Stross set in the near future, exploring themes of technological singularity, artificial intelligence, and post-human evolution through interconnected stories following a family across three generations as humanity navigates an increasingly incomprehensible future shaped by advanced technology.
problem_solved: Provides free access to an acclaimed hard sci-fi novel exploring realistic AI and post-human scenarios.
why_valuable: Written by Hugo Award winner, offers one of the most prescient portrayals of AI advancement and digital consciousness before the current AI boom, making it essential reading for anyone interested in future technology.
